_comment: Official BlocRA endpoint and signing keys, built into the CLI so that `blocra verify report.md` works with no setup. Filled in for each release from the production deployment. official_keys lists every key BlocRA has signed reports with (newest first), so reports signed before a key rotation keep verifying. Example: {"api": "https://blocra-api.onrender.com", "official_keys": ["GABC..."]}
